svg.title: Two continuity routes: which bound to use, and when
svg.desc: The local one-Lambda bound and the support-free bound for the net synergy atom on the AND gate and on a real occupancy law, and where each bound is smaller.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: TWO CONTINUITY ROUTES: WHICH BOUND TO USE, AND WHEN
The local bound (wine) is smaller for almost every η:
a well-conditioned law favors the local route.
The support-free bound (teal) is smaller wherever
the local one applies: 1/pmin is too large.
(c) Which bound is smaller? Local (wine) versus support-free (teal), K = 16 cells
Both bounds held in every case.
The local route needs a common
for balanced laws with few cells.
A rare cell hands the advantage
Bounds for the net synergy atom: local one-Λ route (plus averaging) and support-free route. Seed 20260930.
